en: Psalms 86
A Prayer by David.

p.src: 1  Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

ja: えてください。 私は貧しく、
en: Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
u.src: 1  Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

p.src: 2  Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

ja: ってください。私は敬虔な
en: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
u.src: 2  Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

p.src: 3  Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

ja: よ、私をあわれんでください。 私は
en: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
u.src: 3  Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

p.src: 4  Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

ja: あなたのしもべの魂を
ばせてください。 主よ、私は
en: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
u.src: 4  Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

p.src: 5  For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

ja: してくださる方。 あなたを
en: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
u.src: 5  For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

p.src: 6  Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

ja: りを聞いてください。 私の願いの声に耳を傾けてください。
en: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
u.src: 6  Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

p.src: 7  In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

en: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
u.src: 7  In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

p.src: 8  There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

ja: に、あなたのような方はいない。 あなたの御業に
en: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
u.src: 8  There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

p.src: 9  All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

en: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
u.src: 9  All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

p.src: 10  For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

ja: われる。 あなただけが
en: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
u.src: 10  For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

p.src: 11  Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

ja: えてください。 私はあなたの
を恐れさせてください。
en: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
u.src: 11  Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

p.src: 12  I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

ja: くしてあなたをほめたたえ、 とこしえにあなたの
en: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
u.src: 12  I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

p.src: 13  For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

ja: きいからだ。 あなたは私の
en: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
u.src: 13  For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

ja: 86:13 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 86:13 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 14  God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

ja: らはあなたを心に留めない。
en: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
u.src: 14  God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

p.src: 15  But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

ja: よ、あなたはあわれみ深く、
en: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
u.src: 15  But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

p.src: 16  Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

ja: け、あわれんでください。 あなたのしもべに御力を
え、 あなたのしもべの
en: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
u.src: 16  Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

p.src: 17  Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.

ja: してください。 私を
じるようにしてください。
めてくださったからだ。
en: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.
u.src: 17  Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.
